attributes.description:
A beautifully refurbished 3-bedroom semi-detached house in the heart of Stretford, moments from local amenities and transport links.

The accommodation briefly comprises an entrance hall, a generous lounge, a kitchen diner, 3 bedrooms and a modern bathroom.

Viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the space on offer.

Outside, the rear garden has been landscaped over several years by the current owners and now includes a raised patio, mature borders, a greenhouse, a timber summer house with power and lighting, and a gate onto the rear access lane. To the front there is a block-paved driveway with an electric vehicle charging point. The loft is boarded with a pull-down ladder and the cellar has been tanked, making it suitable for storage or a home gym. Council tax band D. Freehold.
attributes.accessNotes: Tenant in situ. They ask for 24 hours notice.
